summary: Iter 20 v1.11.0 Step 9 + Universal Share placement audit. 16/16 backend tests PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iter20_subs_step9.py. ShareButton placement verified on all listed surfaces (partners=3, governance(partner)=4, join-us(foundation_role)=3, workshops=3, shop=56 across cards+details, facilitators=3, research=2). Workshop_material PDP correctly hides ShareButton (0 triggers on /shop/{material_id}). New Print + Download QR menu items rendered with data-testid share-print-{surface} and share-download-qr-{surface} (verified on workshop card). Admin /admin/subscriptions page renders STATUS + PARTNER TYPE filter dropdowns, ACTIVE pill, and REVOKE button per row. AdminDashboard QuickActionCard 'Subscriptions' wired to /admin/subscriptions in AdminDashboard.jsx line 66. Backend Step 9 endpoints all return correct shapes: cancel (200 + idempotent 400), change-preview (returns 7 expected keys, rejects cross-partner-type 400), change-plan free path (checkout_required=false, supersedes old sub, creates new with supersedes_subscription_id), admin list (enriched with partner_name/email/plan/is_active, filterable, 403 for non-admin), admin revoke (422 for short reason, 200 for valid; both with and without refund record refund field — refund_session catch-block correctly stores {status:error,...} when Stripe session missing). All 5 iter19 regressions (shares.log with via=community-code sets birthright_ref cookie, /me/bookmarks, /admin/payouts/ready-to-pay, /research/{id}/cite?format=apa7, /workshops/{id}/ics) PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/subscriptions.py change_plan free-upgrade path correctly marks the old sub superseded AND create_subscription_from_txn also marks it superseded — this is a double-write but idempotent ($set with same status). Harmless but a single source of truth would be cleaner.

routers/subscriptions.py admin_revoke_subscription wraps refund_session in try/except — good. Records refund_result as None when payment_session_id starts with 'comp_change_' (synthetic free-upgrade session) — correct, no money to refund there.
routers/subscriptions.py _prorated_credit uses (expires-now).days vs (expires-started).days — this is integer-day arithmetic; for sub-day precision use total_seconds(). Acceptable for v1.
ShopParts.jsx correctly gates ShareButton with !isMaterial check (line 70). Verified material PDP shows 0 share triggers.

Governance.jsx uses surface='partner' for board cards — note for next agent: same surface name as PartnersDirectory cards. ShareButton testid is therefore 'share-button-partner-trigger' on both surfaces. If you need to differentiate, consider 'board' surface.
JoinUs.jsx uses surface='foundation_role' — testid is 'share-button-foundation_role-trigger' (with underscore).
AdminSubscriptions.jsx renders status pills, two select filters, and per-row Revoke action (screenshot confirms). Modal revoke with reason+refund is wired per spec.
Backend log_action calls in cancel/change-plan/admin_revoke pass user dict — consistent with other routers.
models.py AdminSubscriptionRevokeRequest validates reason min_length=3 — correctly returns 422 on short reason (test confirms).
